title: CausalWAM: Learning the Causes of Actions in World Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.42096v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World action models (WAMs) learn latent variables from observations and use these to both predict the evolution of the scene and to generate actions. The prediction has to be of the whole scene, whereas only a portion of the scene causes actions. WAMs fitted to demonstrations do not, in general, guarantee that they will generate actions solely from the latent causes of the demonstrated actions (the action-relevant latent variables), as the model could just as well learn to imitate in this way whilst entangling the action-relevant latent variables with the nuisance variables. We therefore separate out what causes action from what prediction depends on. We prove that under a sparsity constraint the latent variables used to generate actions are an invertible function of the action-relevant latent variables alone and the true structure is identified up to a permutation of the latent variables. translated_title: CausalWAM：在世界动作模型中学习动作的因果成因
translated_abstract: 世界动作模型从观测中学习潜变量，并利用这些潜变量来预测场景的演化以及生成动作。预测必须针对整个场景，而场景中只有一部分内容会引发动作。通常来说，通过演示数据拟合的世界动作模型并不能保证仅从演示动作的潜在成因（即与动作相关的潜变量）来生成动作，因为模型完全可能以这种方式学习模仿，同时将与动作相关的潜变量与干扰变量纠缠在一起。因此，我们将引发动作的因素与预测所依赖的因素分离开来。我们证明，在稀疏性约束下，用于生成动作的潜变量仅是动作相关潜变量的可逆函数，且真实结构在潜变量置换的意义下可以被识别。这既不需要充分的时间依赖关系（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出CausalWAM，从理论上证明在稀疏性约束下，可将引发动作的因果潜变量与预测所需的干扰变量解耦，从而确保世界动作模型仅从动作相关的潜在成因生成动作。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CausalWAM, theoretically proving that under a sparsity constraint, the latent variables used to generate actions can be disentangled from nuisance variables, ensuring world action models generate actions solely from the action-relevant latent causes.
